question: Six houses, A, B, C, D, E and F, are situated in a colony. D is 60 m south of E. F is 40 m south of B. A is 30 m north of E. F is 50 m east of A. C is 50 m west of B. Find the location of C with reference to A.
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Six houses, A, B, C, D, E and F, are situated in a colony.

D is 60 m south of E. F is 40 m south of B. A is 30 m north of E. F is 50 m east of A. C is 50 m west of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04231c6f294ff82e5c9d8420aecd6207f589493be686911d59de2ab32aa32037.png] 

∴ Here, House C is located at 40m north with respect to A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"40 ****m north".**
